mapper.sql: select d.*,w.task_id from ndt_defect d join ndt_dicom_object o on o.id=d.original_object_id and o.del_flag='0' join ndt_dicom_series ds on ds.id=o.series_id and ds.del_flag='0' join ndt_inspection_position p on p.id=ds.position_id and p.del_flag='0' join ndt_workpiece w on w.id=p.workpiece_id and w.del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update ndt_defect set defect_no=#{defectNo},defect_type=#{defectType},roi_type=#{roiType},roi_data_json=#{roiDataJson},description=#{description},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update ndt_defect set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where id in #{id}
